package de.eldoria.companies.events.order
  • Class
    Description
    OrderAcceptEvent
    A company accepted an order and claimed it.
    OrderCanceledEvent
    A company aborted a claimed order; the order is open again for other companies.
    OrderCreatedEvent
    An order was created and saved, by a player or through the API.
    OrderDeliveryEvent
    A worker delivered items to an order.
    OrderDoneEvent
    All items of an order are delivered and the owner can receive it.
    OrderEvent<Order extends ISimpleOrder>
    Base of the events about an existing order.
    OrderExpiredEvent
    A company did not deliver a claimed order in time; the order is open again for other companies.
    OrderPaymentEvent
    A worker is about to be paid their share of a completed order.
    OrderReceivedEvent
    The owner received the items of a delivered order.
    OrderRemovedEvent
    An order was deleted before it was delivered: removed because nobody accepted it, cancelled by its owner, or deleted by an admin.
    OrderRemovedEvent.Reason
    Why an order was deleted.
    PreOrderAcceptEvent
    A member of a company is about to accept an order for the company.
    PreOrderCreateEvent
    An order is about to be created, by a player or through the API.
